original_castle_props.style: Original low-poly shapes using the existing KayKit dungeon palette

original_alchemy_assemblies.processing: Selected functional assemblies; removed room architecture; recentered at ground level; reduced meshes; joined meshes; embedded original materials

portrait_compositions.processing: Rendered directly in Godot from existing licensed character models; original framing and studio lighting

license_notice: KayKit-derived textures and models retain their source CC0 license; see KayKit-License.txt. New original compositions and assemblies were created for the Gomstalle project.

interrupted_midnight_feast.design: Original kitchen workflow from pantry and grain milling through food preparation, roasting, washing, and service; banquet tables with distinct full and interrupted settings, silver display, and royal dais.
interrupted_midnight_feast.processing: Joined material meshes, applied transforms, sRGB palette converted to linear shader values, separate non-overlapping lightmap UVs.

midnight_library.design: Original two-level reading gallery with fitted bookcases, oak balustrades, bound books, card catalogue, binding press, illuminated reading tables, and celestial globe.
midnight_library.processing: Spatial and material mesh batches, softened edges, weighted normals, linear shader colors, and simplified collision surfaces.

castle_halls_and_wine_cellar.design: Original gatehouse reception with sealed outer gate, castle model, notices and luggage; raised audience court and organ gallery connected by four walkable stairways; working wine cellar with staved barrels, timber cradles, decanting and corking bench, bottle racks and transport trolley.
castle_halls_and_wine_cellar.processing: Joined material meshes with non-overlapping lightmap UVs, applied bevels and linear shader colors; explicit collision surfaces with continuous stair slopes.
